overview: This enum chooses the battle effect that a binding vow applies, such as health, Cursed Energy, movement, damage, or mission rewards.

None.technical: EGameBindingVowsEffectType::None is the constructor default for FGameDataTableRow_BindingVowsEffect. BindingVows_GetCategoryType maps it to EGameWidgetBindingVowsCategoryType::Invalid. No exported effect row uses this type.

ForceGaugeMax.simple: Raises or lowers the maximum force gauge.
ForceGaugeMax.technical: GameBindingVows_ApplyForceGaugeMax adds each matching EffectValue[0] to the integer base and clamps nonnegative results to at least 1. Negative bases pass through unchanged. GamePvE_CalcForceGaugeMax applies the same addition to the PvE force gauge rule. Exported values are -1 and 1.

ForceGaugeBarrier.simple: Grants spare force gauge stock that absorbs a knockout loss.
ForceGaugeBarrier.technical: GamePhase_BattlePvEBase::GetBattleSideRule2 sums EffectValue[0] over the player vow rows and passes the total to SetCharacterStockReserve. SetCharacterStock consumes one reserve charge when a lower stock value is applied. The exported row has EffectValue 1 and 0.

Cost.simple: Changes how much force gauge a fighter spends when knocked out.
Cost.technical: GamePhase_BattlePvESolo and GamePhase_BattlePvETag add summed EffectValue[0] to the row Cost and store the result in StatusSetup.Int44. InitializeStatus copies Int44 to MissionCharacterCost, which GetStockAfterLoss uses on defeat. Exported values are 1 and 99.

HitPointMax.simple: Adds or removes flat maximum health.
HitPointMax.technical: GamePvE_CalcHitPoint sums EffectValue[0] over the player vow rows and adds the result to the base health calculation before flooring at 1. Exported flat values range from -150 to 100.

HitPointMaxRate.technical: GamePvE_CalcHitPoint starts a multiplier at 1, multiplies it by each matching EffectValue[0], and floors the product at 1e-8 before applying it to base health. The exported row has EffectValue 0.5.

HitPointMaxRateAlly.simple: Raises the whole team maximum health.
HitPointMaxRateAlly.technical: GamePvE_CalcHitPoint collects these rows across all allied vows, multiplies EffectValue[0] into the team multiplier, and replaces the product with the largest single value when that maximum is positive. The result is floored at 1e-8. The exported row has EffectValue 1.5.

HitPointWhenKill.simple: Heals surviving allies after the vow holder scores a knockout.
HitPointWhenKill.technical: GetKillHitPointRate sums EffectValue[0] over these rows. GameBattleSystems_A applies the result times each surviving teammate HitPointMax when the attacker knocks out a character. The export shard has no row of this type.

HitPointWhenJustGuard.simple: Heals the fighter after a successful perfect guard.
HitPointWhenJustGuard.technical: ApplyJustGuardHitPointGain rolls int32(EffectValue[0] * 100) out of 100 for each matching row and adds HitPointMax * EffectValue[1] on success. Exported chances run from 0.05 to 0.2 and EffectValue[1] is 1.

HitPointWhenJustGuardAlly.simple: Heals the whole team after a perfect guard.
HitPointWhenJustGuardAlly.technical: GetHitPointWhenJustGuardAllyFromBindingVows sums EffectValue[0] over these rows. GameBattleSystems_A applies the result times each surviving teammate HitPointMax. The exported row has EffectValue 0.25.

HitPointWhenSendDamage.simple: Heals the fighter for a share of damage dealt.
HitPointWhenSendDamage.technical: GetHitPointWhenSendDamageRate sums EffectValue[0] over these rows plus an equipment amount. GameCharacter::OnDamageDealt multiplies the result by damage and adds it to current health when the hit comes from another actor. The exported row has EffectValue 0.5.

HitPointWhenNormalAttackAlly.simple: Heals teammates when the fighter lands a normal attack.
HitPointWhenNormalAttackAlly.technical: GetHitPointWhenNormalAttackAllyValue uses GameBindingVows_SumRolledEffectValue, which rolls int32(EffectValue[0] * 100) out of 100 and sums EffectValue[1] on success. GameBattleSystems_A applies that result times each surviving teammate HitPointMax. Exported chances run from 0.1 to 0.4 and magnitudes from 0.1 to 0.2.

HitPointWhenSpecialTagComboAlly.simple: Heals teammates when a special tag combo connects.
HitPointWhenSpecialTagComboAlly.technical: FStudioBattleSystem380::GetHitPointWhenSpecialTagComboAllyValue takes the largest EffectValue[0] across the player team vows and returns 0 for other teams. GameBattleState_06 adds that value times HitPointMax to each member health. The exported row has EffectValue 1.

HitPointWithTime.technical: GetHitPointWithTimeValue sums EffectValue[0] over these rows plus equipment and buff amounts. Tick multiplies the result by DeltaTime and adds it to health while the fighter is alive, with health floored at 1. The exported row has EffectValue -1, which removes 1 health per second.

HitPointWithTimeAlly.simple: Grants health over time to the whole team.
HitPointWithTimeAlly.technical: FStudioBattleSystem380::GetHitPointWithTimeAllyValue takes the largest EffectValue[0] over team A vows and returns 0 for other teams. GameCharacter::GetHitPointWithTimeValue adds it to the character own per-second health change, which Tick multiplies by DeltaTime. The exported row has EffectValue 2.

HitPointOnce.simple: Restores a slice of health once when health falls low.
HitPointOnce.technical: Each matching row with EffectValue[0] at or above the health ratio is considered. GetVowUseCount skips rows already used for the character and AddVowUse marks them. Health increases by int32(EffectValue[1] * HitPointMax). Exported rows use a threshold of 0.4 and magnitudes from 0.1 to 0.5.

CursedEnergyRecover.simple: Changes how fast the fighter recovers Cursed Energy.
CursedEnergyRecover.technical: GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate sums EffectValue[0] - 1 over matching rows into the recovery multiplier and floors the result at 0. Exported values run from 0.5 to 1.5.

CursedEnergyWhenDash.simple: Restores Cursed Energy after a dash.
CursedEnergyWhenDash.technical: ConsumeDashGaugeBegin calls GameBindingVows_SumRolledEffectValue, which rolls int32(EffectValue[0] * 100) out of 100 and adds EffectValue[1] to Cursed Energy on success. Exported chances run from 0.1 to 0.5 and flat amounts from 40 to 100.

CursedEnergyUnlimited.technical: SetCursedEnergy returns early when this effect is present and the new value is below current Cursed Energy. The exported row has EffectValue 0 and 0, so row presence activates the flag.

CursedEnergyExp.simple: Changes how fast Cursed Energy experience is gained.
CursedEnergyExp.technical: GetCursedEnergyExpRate sums EffectValue[0] - 1 into the experience multiplier and floors the result at 0. Exported values run from 0.5 to 0.95 and reduce the gain.

CursedEnergyExpAlly.simple: Raises the whole team Cursed Energy experience gain.
CursedEnergyExpAlly.technical: FStudioBattleSystem380::GetCursedEnergyExpRate takes the largest EffectValue[0] - 1 across team A vows and adds 1. Other teams return 1. The exported row has EffectValue 2.

CursedEnergyExpWhenLinkCombo.simple: Grants Cursed Energy experience after a link combo.
CursedEnergyExpWhenLinkCombo.technical: GameBindingVows_SumRolledEffectValue rolls int32(EffectValue[0] * 100) out of 100 and adds EffectValue[1] to the link combo experience gain on success. Exported chances run from 0.1 to 0.3 and flat amounts from 50 to 100.

CursedEnergyExpWhenKillAlly.simple: Grants Cursed Energy experience to allies after a knockout.
CursedEnergyExpWhenKillAlly.technical: GetKillCursedEnergyExp uses GameBindingVows_SumRolledEffectValue. On a knockout, GameBattleSystems_A passes the result to each surviving teammate AddCursedEnergyExp. Exported chances run from 0.1 to 0.3 and the flat amount is 100.

CursedEnergyExpWithTime.simple: Boosts Cursed Energy experience early in the battle.
CursedEnergyExpWithTime.technical: GameBindingVows_SumEffectRateAtValue compares battle elapsed time with EffectValue[0] using the at-most test and adds EffectValue[1] - 1 when elapsed time is at or below the threshold. Exported thresholds run from 60 to 100 and the multiplier is 2.

CursedEnergyExpRecoverWithTime.technical: GetCursedEnergyExpRecoverWithTimeValue sums raw EffectValue[0] over matching rows. Tick multiplies the result by DeltaTime and passes it to AddCursedEnergyExp. The exported row has EffectValue 2, which adds 2 experience per second.

CursedEnergyLevelUpCount.simple: Limits how much a vow can push Cursed Energy levels upward.
CursedEnergyLevelUpCount.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords reads the total send log CursedEnergy_LevelUp value into Current and sets Required to EffectValue[0]. SetCursedEnergyGauge blocks buff-driven gauge increases once the requirement is met and clamps a completed level-up to the remaining count. Exported requirements are 3, 5, 8 and 10.

CursedEnergyLevelMax.simple: Lowers the starting Cursed Energy level in PvE.
CursedEnergyLevelMax.technical: GamePvE_GetBindingVowLevel sums EffectValue[0] over these rows, adds 3, and clamps the result to the range 0 through 3. Exported values are -1 and -2.

CursedEnergyLevelFull.simple: Starts the fighter at full Cursed Energy level.
CursedEnergyLevelFull.technical: AGameCharacter::Initialize checks records of this type and sets SetupCursedEnergyLevel from StatusSetup.Int40 + 1. The character manager later calls SetCursedEnergyToLevel with that value. bResetCursedEnergyLevelOnRoundReset is cleared. The exported row has EffectValue 0 and 0.

CursedEnergyLevelFullAndSendAttackDamage.simple: Starts at full Cursed Energy level and boosts attack damage.
CursedEnergyLevelFullAndSendAttackDamage.technical: AGameCharacter::Initialize treats this type like CursedEnergyLevelFull for the start level override. GetSendAttackDamageRate also adds EffectValue[0] - 1 from these rows to the outgoing damage multiplier. The exported row has EffectValue 2.

MoveSpeed.technical: GetMoveSpeedRate sums EffectValue[0] - 1 into the movement multiplier, floors the result at 0, and applies MoveSpeedRateScale. Exported values run from 0.5 to 0.9 and slow the fighter.

MoveSpeedEnemy.technical: FStudioBattleSystem380::GetMoveSpeedEnemyRate adds EffectValue[0] - 1 from the player vows to the multiplier applied to a rival team character. Team A characters return 1. Exported values run from 0.75 to 0.95.

RunLimit.simple: Blocks running while the vow is active.
RunLimit.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords sets Current and Required to 0 for this type, so IsBindingVowsEffectMet is true whenever a row is present. FGameCharacterAction::RequestBindingVowsPenalty replaces RunBegin with BindingVowsPenalty. The exported row has EffectValue 0 and 0.

JumpCount.simple: Limits how many jumps the fighter can make.
JumpCount.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords reads the total send log Jump value into Current and sets Required to EffectValue[0]. IsBindingVowsEffectMet becomes true once Current reaches the requirement, and the action layer requests BindingVowsPenaltyAir for jump begins. Exported requirements are 0, 1, 3, 5 and 8.

JumpPower.technical: GetJumpPowerRate sums EffectValue[0] - 1 into the jump power multiplier and floors the result at 0. Exported values run from 0.5 to 0.9.

RunJumpLimitWithoutHitPointMax.simple: Blocks running and jumping until health is full.
RunJumpLimitWithoutHitPointMax.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords sets Current to 0. Required becomes 0 when health is below HitPointMax or HitPointMax is nonpositive, and 1 when health is at full. IsBindingVowsEffectMet therefore returns true while health is below full, and action code requests binding-vow penalties for RunBegin and jump begins. The exported row has EffectValue 1 and 0.

DashGaugeMax.technical: GetDashGaugeMaxRate adds EffectValue[0] - 1 from these rows to the dash gauge multiplier before multiplying by the action row gauge value. Exported multipliers range from 0.5 to 2.0.

DashGaugeConsume.simple: Changes how much dash gauge a dash spends.
DashGaugeConsume.technical: GetDashGaugeConsumeRate adds EffectValue[0] - 1 to the dash cost multiplier and floors the result at 0. An active DashGaugeUnlimited vow or DashGaugeUnlimitedItem stack clears the multiplier. Exported values run from 1.1 to 1.5 and raise the cost.

DashGaugeWhenJump.simple: Refills dash gauge after a jump.
DashGaugeWhenJump.technical: RecoverDashGaugeOnJump sums EffectValue[0] over these rows, multiplies the total by the dash gauge maximum, and caps the result at that maximum. Exported values run from 0.2 to 1.0.

DashGaugeWhenDamage.simple: Changes dash gauge when the fighter takes damage.
DashGaugeWhenDamage.technical: OnDamageReceivedDashGauge sums EffectValue[0] over these rows, multiplies by the dash gauge maximum, and adds the result to current gauge before clamping to the maximum. The exported row has EffectValue -0.25, which reduces gauge by a quarter of the maximum.

DashGaugeUnlimited.technical: GetDashGaugeConsumeRate sets the cost multiplier to 0 when GameBindingVows_HasEffect finds this type. The export shard has no row of this type, so this is the only traced consumer.

DashGaugeUnlimitedAlly.simple: Makes dashing free for the whole team.
DashGaugeUnlimitedAlly.technical: FStudioBattleSystem380::GetDashGaugeConsumeAllyRate returns 0 for team A when this type is present on the player vows and returns 1 otherwise. The exported row has EffectValue 0 and 0.

StepCount.simple: Limits how many steps the fighter can take.
StepCount.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords reads the total send log Step value into Current and sets Required to EffectValue[0]. IsBindingVowsEffectMet becomes true once the count reaches the requirement, and Step and StepAir request binding-vow penalties. Exported requirements are 1, 3, 5, 8 and 10.

StepRigidity.simple: Changes how long step recovery takes.
StepRigidity.technical: GetStepEndPlayRate and GetStepAirEndPlayRate subtract EffectValue[0] - 1 from the action row play rate and floor at 0.0001. Exported values run from 1.1 to 1.5 and shorten recovery.

GuardCount.simple: Limits how many guards the fighter can raise.
GuardCount.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords reads the total log Guard value with receive mode into Current and sets Required to EffectValue[0]. Guard and GuardAir request binding-vow penalties when the requirement is met. Exported requirements are 5, 8 and 10.

GuardDurabilityMax.technical: GetGuardDurabilityMaxRate adds EffectValue[0] - 1 into the guard durability multiplier and floors the total at 0 before multiplying the base guard durability. Exported multipliers range from 0.5 to 2.0.

GuardDurabilityUnlimitedAlly.technical: FStudioBattleSystem380::GetGuardDurabilityDamageRate returns 0 for team A when this type is present on the player vows and returns 1 otherwise. The exported row has EffectValue 0 and 0.

GuardBreakRigidity.simple: Changes stagger after a guard break.
GuardBreakRigidity.technical: GetGuardBreakRigidityRate subtracts EffectValue[0] - 1 from 1 and floors at 0.0001. Exported values run from 1.1 to 1.5 and shorten the stagger.

DashStepJumpLimit.simple: Applies a penalty to dashing, stepping, and jumping.
DashStepJumpLimit.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords sets Current and Required to 0 for this type, so the penalty condition is always met when the row exists. Action code requests BindingVowsPenalty or BindingVowsPenaltyAir for dashes, steps, and jumps. The exported row has EffectValue 0 and 0.

NormalAttackSuperArmor.simple: Grants armor against interruption during normal attacks.
NormalAttackSuperArmor.technical: HasNormalAttackSuperArmorVow calls GameBindingVows_HasEffect for this type. FGameCharacterAction_NormalAttackBase::IsSuperArmorEnabled returns true when the vow is present. The exported row has EffectValue 0 and 0.

SpecialTagComboCount.simple: Limits how many special tag combos the fighter can perform.
SpecialTagComboCount.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords reads the total send log SpecialTagCombo_Count value and sets Required to EffectValue[0]. The action layer requests BindingVowsPenaltyAir for first normal attack actions when the requirement is met. Exported requirements are 1, 3, 5 and 8.

SendAttackDamage.simple: Changes the damage the fighter deals.
SendAttackDamage.technical: GetSendAttackDamageRate adds EffectValue[0] - 1 from these rows to the outgoing damage rate and floors the final rate at 0.01. Exported multipliers range from 0.5 to 2.0.

SendAttackDamageWithTime.simple: Changes attack damage while the battle is early.
SendAttackDamageWithTime.technical: GameBindingVows_SumEffectRateAtValue uses the at-most test with battle elapsed time against EffectValue[0] and adds EffectValue[1] - 1 when time is at or below the threshold. Exported thresholds run from 60 to 100 with multipliers from 0.5 to 2.2.

SendAttackDamageWithTimeHigher.simple: Changes attack damage after battle time passes a threshold.
SendAttackDamageWithTimeHigher.technical: GameBindingVows_SumEffectRateAtValue uses the at-least test, so EffectValue[1] - 1 applies when elapsed time is at or above EffectValue[0]. The exported row has threshold 60 and multiplier 0.5.

SendAttackDamageEveryWithTime.simple: Multiplies attack damage again for every interval that passes.
SendAttackDamageEveryWithTime.technical: GetSendAttackDamageRate counts int32(Elapsed / EffectValue[0]) intervals and multiplies the rate by EffectValue[1] once per interval. Exported rows use intervals of 45 or 60 and a factor of 0.5.

SendAttackDamageAlly.simple: Raises the whole team attack damage.
SendAttackDamageAlly.technical: FStudioBattleSystem380::GetSendAttackDamageRate takes the largest EffectValue[0] - 1 over team A vows, adds 1, and adds any stored kill bonus. The exported row has EffectValue 2.

SendAttackDamageWhenHitPointMaxRateAlly.simple: Boosts the team damage when health falls.
SendAttackDamageWhenHitPointMaxRateAlly.technical: For each team A character, FStudioBattleSystem380 computes the health ratio and GameBindingVows_SumEffectRateAtValue uses the at-most test. The largest EffectValue[1] - 1 is added to the team damage rate. The exported row has threshold 0.5 and multiplier 1.6.

SendAttackDamageWhenKillAlly.simple: Boosts the team damage after each knockout.
SendAttackDamageWhenKillAlly.technical: AddKillAllyBonus sums EffectValue[0] - 1 from these rows into SendAttackDamageAllyBonus for the attacker team. GetSendAttackDamageRate adds that stored bonus to outgoing damage. The exported row has EffectValue 1.5.

SendAttackDamageAndCursedEnergyRecoverWi.simple: Improves damage and Cursed Energy recovery when health is high.
SendAttackDamageAndCursedEnergyRecoverWi.technical: GameBindingVows_SumEffectRateAtValue uses the at-least test with the health ratio and EffectValue[0]. It adds EffectValue[1] - 1 to outgoing damage in GetSendAttackDamageRate and to the Cursed Energy recovery multiplier in GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate. Exported rows have threshold 1 and multipliers 2 and 3.

SendGuardDurabilityDamage.simple: Changes damage dealt to an enemy guard.
SendGuardDurabilityDamage.technical: GetSendGuardDurabilityDamageRate sums EffectValue[0] - 1 into the guard durability damage rate. For cursed energy attacks it also adds the matching rate from SendCursedEnergyAttackGuardDurabilityDamage. Exported multipliers range from 0.7 to 2.0.

SendGuardDurabilityDamageAlly.simple: Raises the team damage to enemy guards.
SendGuardDurabilityDamageAlly.technical: FStudioBattleSystem380::GetSendGuardDurabilityDamageAllyRate takes the largest EffectValue[0] - 1 over team A vows and adds 1. Other teams return 1. The export shard has no row of this type.

SendCursedEnergyAttackGuardDurabilityDam.simple: Boosts guard damage from Cursed Energy attacks.
SendCursedEnergyAttackGuardDurabilityDam.technical: When the damage row has AttackType CursedEnergyAttack_1 or CursedEnergyAttack_2, GetSendGuardDurabilityDamageRate adds EffectValue[0] - 1 from these rows. Exported multipliers range from 1.4 to 2.0.

SendSuperCursedEnergyAttackDamage.simple: Boosts damage from a super Cursed Energy attack.
SendSuperCursedEnergyAttackDamage.technical: GetSendAttackDamageRate adds EffectValue[0] - 1 only when the damage row AttackType is SuperCursedEnergyAttack. Exported multipliers range from 1.2 to 100.

SendSpecialTagComboDamage.technical: FStudioBattleSystem380::GetSendAttackDamageRate adds EffectValue[0] - 1 for team A when the damage row AttackType is SpecialTagCombo. Exported multipliers range from 1.2 to 2.0.

SendSpecialTagComboDamageWithProb.simple: Sometimes boosts special tag combo damage.
SendSpecialTagComboDamageWithProb.technical: GameBindingVows_SumRolledEffectRate rolls int32(EffectValue[0] * 100) out of 100 for each row and adds EffectValue[1] - 1 on success. The bonus applies to team A special tag combo hits. Exported chances run from 0.05 to 0.2 and multipliers from 1.1 to 1.2.

ReceiveDamage.technical: GetReceiveDamageRate adds EffectValue[0] - 1 to the incoming damage multiplier. The exported row has EffectValue 2, which doubles damage taken.

ReceiveDamageWhenAttack.simple: Adds a fixed amount to damage taken.
ReceiveDamageWhenAttack.technical: GetReceiveDamageWhenAttackValue sums raw EffectValue[0] over these rows and adds HitPointMax when a rolled DeadReceiveAttack effect succeeds. GameCharacter::CalcReceivedDamage adds the result to scaled incoming damage. The exported row has EffectValue 30.

ReceiveDamageWhenWallBound.simple: Adds damage when slammed into a wall.
ReceiveDamageWhenWallBound.technical: GetReceiveDamageWhenWallBoundValue sums raw EffectValue[0]. GameCharacterAction_Blow subtracts that value from health, floored at 1, on a wall bound. The exported row has EffectValue 30.

ReceiveDamageZeroWhenAttack.simple: Can cancel all damage from an incoming hit.
ReceiveDamageZeroWhenAttack.technical: GameBindingVows_HasRolledEffect rolls int32(EffectValue[0] * 100) out of 100 for each matching row. A success sets the incoming damage rate to 0. Exported chances run from 0.05 to 0.3.

DeadWaveClearWithTime.simple: Fails the vow when the round time runs out.
DeadWaveClearWithTime.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords reads the current round TimeLimit send log into Current and sets Required to EffectValue[0]. FStudioBattleSystem380::Tick marks the vow failed after time reaches the requirement and applies BINDING_VOWS_DEAD once. The exported row has threshold 90.

DeadCursedEnergyLevelWithTime.simple: Fails the vow if Cursed Energy level is too low when time runs out.
DeadCursedEnergyLevelWithTime.technical: Current comes from the current round TimeLimit log and Required from EffectValue[0]. After the time passes, GetCursedEnergyLevelClamped must exceed EffectValue[1] or the vow fails and applies BINDING_VOWS_DEAD. The exported row uses threshold 60 and level 1.

DeadKillWithTime.simple: Fails the vow if too few knockouts happen before time runs out.
DeadKillWithTime.technical: Current comes from the current round TimeLimit log and Required from EffectValue[0]. After the time passes, the total Dead send log must reach EffectValue[1] or the vow fails and applies BINDING_VOWS_DEAD. The exported row uses threshold 60 and 1 knockout.

DeadPenalty.simple: Fails the vow after repeated binding-vow penalties.
DeadPenalty.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords reads the total BindingVowsPenalty receive log into Current and sets Required to EffectValue[0]. FStudioBattleSystem380::Tick applies BINDING_VOWS_DEAD when the requirement is reached. The exported row has requirement 3.

DeadSendGuard.simple: Fails the vow after enough guards.
DeadSendGuard.technical: GetBindingVowsRecords reads the total Guard send log into Current and sets Required to EffectValue[0]. FStudioBattleSystem380::Tick applies BINDING_VOWS_DEAD when the requirement is reached. The export shard has no row of this type.

DeadReceiveSpecialTagCombo.simple: Makes special tag combo hits hurt more.
DeadReceiveSpecialTagCombo.technical: When the incoming damage row AttackType is SpecialTagCombo, GetReceiveDamageRate uses GameBindingVows_SumRolledEffectRate. Each row rolls int32(EffectValue[0] * 100) out of 100 and adds EffectValue[1] - 1 on success. The exported row uses chance 0.3 and multiplier 100.

DeadReceiveAttack.technical: GetReceiveDamageWhenAttackValue calls GameBindingVows_HasRolledEffect with this type, which rolls int32(EffectValue[0] * 100) out of 100 and returns true on success. A success adds HitPointMax flat damage to the hit. The exported row uses chance 1.

ExperienceWhenMissionClear.simple: Increases experience earned from winning a mission.
ExperienceWhenMissionClear.technical: GamePvE_CalcResultExperience starts the win rate at 1, adds EffectValue[0] - 1 from these rows, and floors at 1 before multiplying the experience total. The exported row has EffectValue 2.

MoneyAndExperienceWhenMissionClear.simple: Increases both money and experience from a mission win.
MoneyAndExperienceWhenMissionClear.technical: GamePvE_CalcResultMoney and GamePvE_CalcResultExperience each add EffectValue[0] - 1 from these rows to their win rate and floor at 1. The exported row has EffectValue 2.

MoneyWhenMissionClear.simple: Increases money earned from winning a mission.
MoneyWhenMissionClear.technical: GamePvE_CalcResultMoney adds EffectValue[0] - 1 from these rows to the win rate and floors at 1 before multiplying the money total. The exported row has EffectValue 2.

GetExperienceWhenMissionFailure.simple: Reduces experience earned after losing a mission.
GetExperienceWhenMissionFailure.technical: GamePvE_CalcResultExperience adds raw EffectValue[0] to a starting rate of 1 and clamps to the range 0 through 1 on a loss. The exported row has EffectValue -0.25.

GetMoneyAndExperienceWhenMissionFailure.simple: Reduces both money and experience after losing a mission.
GetMoneyAndExperienceWhenMissionFailure.technical: GamePvE_CalcResultMoney and GamePvE_CalcResultExperience each add raw EffectValue[0] to the loss rate and clamp to the range 0 through 1. The exported row has EffectValue -0.25.

GetMoneyWhenMissionFailure.simple: Reduces money earned after losing a mission.
GetMoneyWhenMissionFailure.technical: GamePvE_CalcResultMoney adds raw EffectValue[0] to a starting loss rate of 1 and clamps to the range 0 through 1. The exported row has EffectValue -0.25.

Invalid.technical: EGameBindingVowsEffectType::Invalid is the 255 sentinel. BindingVows_GetCategoryType maps it to EGameWidgetBindingVowsCategoryType::Invalid. No exported effect row and no gameplay consumer use this value.

notes: The enum header and the authoritative enums.json list the same 82 members in the same order, with sequential values through 80 and Invalid at 255.

FGameDataTableRow_BindingVowsEffect defaults EffectType to None. The export shard has 239 rows covering 76 of the 80 behavior values. HitPointWhenKill, DashGaugeUnlimited, SendGuardDurabilityDamageAlly and DeadSendGuard have traced C++ consumers with no exported row.

Rate helpers such as GameBindingVows_SumEffectRate subtract 1 from EffectValue[0]. Flat helpers such as GameBindingVows_SumEffectValue use raw EffectValue[0]. Chance helpers roll int32(EffectValue[0] * 100) out of 100 and use EffectValue[1].
GameBindingVows_SumEffectRateAtValue uses EffectValue[0] as a threshold and EffectValue[1] - 1 as the rate. The at-least flag selects greater-or-equal and the other mode selects less-or-equal.
GameBindingVows_GetEffectRows resolves the first vow row and the first effect row in the loaded table arrays. GameBindingVows_GetEffectRowsOfType filters those resolved rows and preserves order.

GetBindingVowsRecords maps battle-log ids 0x37, 0x32, 0x33, 0x2F, 0x21, 0x20 and 0x47 to level-ups, jumps, steps, guards, special tag combos, elapsed time and binding-vow penalties. A total flag selects total logs and the other mode selects the current round.
Elapsed-time thresholds use GetBattleElapsedTime and current-round TimeLimit logs. Exported thresholds of 45 through 100 are consistent with seconds. The source has no unit annotation.
None and Invalid have traced default and icon-category handling only. Their gameplay behavior is unresolved beyond those paths.
Every exported effect row has two EffectValue entries. Runtime helpers index both without bounds checks.
